'''Paolo Emilio Ricci''' ({{birth date|1944|2|4|df=y}}) is an Italian [[mathematician]], working on [[mathematical physics]], [[orthogonal polynomials]], [[special functions]], [[numerical analysis]], [[approximation theory]] and other related subjects [[mathematical analysis]], [[Elliptic partial differential equation|theory of elliptic partial differential equations]] and [[special functions]]: he is also known for his work collaboration with [[Johan Gielis]].

==Education and academic career==

Paolo Emilio Ricci received his [[Laurea]] [[Academic degree|degree]] ([[cum laude]]) on 7 July 1967, at the Sapienza University of Rome:<ref name="2023p1">According to {{harvtxt|Ricci|2023|p=1}}.</ref> his thesis supervisor was Gaetano Fichera.<ref>See {{harvtxt|Ricci|2017|p=1}}, {{harvtxt|Ricci|2023|p=1}}, {{harvtxt|Bretti|Cesarano|Vinti|2024|p=iii}}.</ref>

After his graduation he was appointed [[assistant professor]] to the chair of Mathematical Analysis II again at the Sapienza University of Rome for the 1967-1968 [[academic year]].<ref name="2023p1"/> From 1969 to 1980 he worked as an assistant to the same chair, except for the years 1970-71 when he did his military service as a second lieutenant in the [[Italian Corps of Military Engineers]].<ref name="2023p1"/>

In 1979 he won the ministerial competition for a chair of numerical analysis and become [[associate professor]]:<ref name="2023p1"/> as a consequence of his election, from November 1, 1980, to October 31, 1981, he worked as an [[academic ranks in Italy|ordinary professor]] of numerical analysis at the University of Catania.<ref name="2023p1"/><ref name="2025piii">See also {{harv|Bretti|Cesarano|Vinti|2024|p=iii}}.</ref>

From November 1, 1981, to November 1, 1990, he held the chair of Mathematical Analysis I at the Faculty of Engineering of the Sapienza University of Rome,<ref name="2023p1"/> first as an assistant professor and after the 1983 as an [[ordinary professor]].<ref name="2023p2">According to {{harvtxt|Ricci|2023|p=2}}.</ref> From 1990 to the year of his retirement (2009) he held the chair of numerical analysis at the Faculty of Natural, Physical and Mathematical Sciences of the Sapienza University of Rome:<ref name="2023p2"/> after his retirement he accepted professor position in the Università telematica internazionale Uninettuno, ad this is currently his work.<ref name="2023p2"/><ref name="2025piii"/>

He has also been director of the [[Rendiconti di Matematica e delle sue Applicazioni|Rendiconti di Matematica]] in 1983 and for three years from 1984 to 1986 and then for six years, from 1987 to 1989 and from 1990 to 1992, jointly with [[Pietro Benvenuti (mathematician)|Pietro Benvenuti]].<ref>According to the relevant [[Rendiconti di Matematica e delle sue Applicazioni#Timeline of Journal series and editors in chief|journal timeline]].</ref>

==Honors==

On 10 September 2003, he was awarded [[Doctor Honoris Causa]] by the I. Vekua Institute of Applied Mathematics of the [[Ivane Javakhishvili Tbilisi State University]].<ref name="Vekua"/>

On May 24-28, 2009, on the occasion of his retirement, the conference "Advanced Special Functions and Solutions of PDEs" in honor of Paolo Emilio Ricci was held in [[Sabaudia]].<ref>Note that while all the contributions to the conference, i.e. the conference proceedings {{harv|Cialdea et al|2010}}, are available online as the 10th volume of the [[Lecture Notes of Seminario Interdisciplinare di Matematica]], the preface by {{harvtxt|Cialdea et al|2010|p=viii}} to the print volume is not.</ref>

In 2015, during the workshop "Modeling in Mathematics",<ref>{{harv|Gielis|Ricci|Tavkhelidze|2017}}.</ref> for his contributions to geometry and mathematics, he was awarded the second [[Stevin Prize|Simon Stevin Prize]] for Geometry.<ref name="Stevin"/>

In 2017, he received the "Life-long achievement award of Vijnana Parishad" of India,<ref name="LifeLong"/> followed in 2022 by "Golden Jubilee Award of Vijnana Parishad of India".<ref name="Golden"/> on the  occasion of the 5th International Conference on Recent Advances in Mathematical Sciences with Applications in Engineering and Technology.<ref>{{harv|Vijñāna Parishad of India|2024}}.</ref>

On 23–24 May 2024, a conference in honor of Paolo Emilio Ricci on his 80th Birthday was held in Rome at the [[Istituto per le Applicazioni del Calcolo Mauro Picone|Istituto per le Applicazioni del Calcolo "Mauro Picone"  IAC - CNR]].<ref>For other details, see [[#{{sfnRef|Bretti et al|2024}}|the conference web site]]. The conference proceedings have been published as a special issue of the journal [[Constructive Mathematical analysis]] {{harv|Bretti|Cesarano|Vinti|2024}}.</ref>
